bundle.shortDescription: Mail in your tray: a quick look, a clear decision – be spex
bundle.longDescription:
Maillet is a mail client that lives in the system tray and organises mail
around what you do with it: see what is new at a glance, turn a mail into a
task and keep track of where it stands. One-time passwords and login links
show up the moment they arrive and are copied or opened with one click.

Maillet reads, sorts and manages your IMAP mail; it does not write mails yet.

Part of be spex – apps for the way you work: https://bespex.github.io
